text:
jules: heads-up — product asked for a new column showing "cache credits applied" on the econ table. current mockups show only net_tokens which hides the raw burn. we should decide UX and API shape before I merge.

kevin: agree, net-only is risky. show three columns: tokens_burned, cache_credits, tokens_net. tiny tooltip on credits explaining attribution window (batch-level, distributed).

mina: telemetry note: cache credits come from a post-processor that amortizes batch prefetches. we currently compute credits per-batch and then distribute to invocations. that's expensive to join for every live query. propose a nightly materialized view `econ.cache_credit_alloc_v2` with tenant/day granularity for dashboard reads.

pat: for exports, billing wants a CSV with both raw and net and a per-row `credit_source` tag (e.g., prefetch, shared-prefetch). can we include that without exploding query cost?

mina: we can include credit_source only in the export job (async) since it requires lineage joins. real-time UI will show aggregated credits and a details modal that calls the export endpoint on demand.

ops-bot: alert: nightly-job:cache-credit-backfill failed 2x in a row (retry scheduled).

jules: thanks for flag, ops-bot. that backfill is critical for the 90d historical sparkline product asked for.

kevin: another concern: quotas are enforced on tokens_burned. showing tokens_net without clear labeling will lead customers to expect quota consumption to be lower. let's add small red badge next to quota usage that reads "quota = raw tokens".

ashley: API question — internal endpoint GET /internal/econ/tenant_summary returns { tokens: int }. Can we add optional fields for credits and sample_rate? some consumers will choke if shape changes.

mina: keep backwards compat: add `tokens_raw` (required), `cache_credits` (nullable), `sample_rate_percent` (nullable). update swagger with new definitions and mark cache_credits as non-blocking.

jules: rollout plan: feature-flag the UI to show net by default only for internal tenants. external rollout to 3 customers in canary. monitor: delta between raw and net > 30% spikes, number of support tickets referencing "billing", and export jobs failures.

kevin: on telemetry sampling: current cache attribution sampling is 0.5% for low-traffic tenants. we should surface sampling percent adjacent to the net numbers and hide net when sample < 2%.

ashley: agree. also add a small help link that explains why net is an estimate and how to reconcile with billing exports.

pat: for the export CSV, include a `confidence` column computed from sample_rate and invocation_count: e.g., CI_estimated_pct. billing can use that for reconciliation.

jules: action items: (1) mina -> create materialized view econ.cache_credit_alloc_v2 + backfill for 90d; (2) ashley -> update internal API schema and swagger; (3) kevin -> add quota badge + help link; (4) pat -> enhance export to include credit_source & confidence. I'll own the feature flag and canary metrics.

mina: estimate view + backfill ~6h compute for full org if we run incremental jobs; I'll kick it off tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: notice: deploy:db-migrations queued (ticket #9876).

jules: perfect. keep me posted here if backfill or migrations block the canary. small follow-up: can we add a tiny sparkline show/hide toggle so the row stays compact? product likes compact rows for large tenant lists.

kevin: simple toggle should be fine; we'll default to hidden.

jules: thanks team. closing thread unless someone wants to add objections.
